theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ff_cyclotomic_supply
theorems.statement: ∀ (M : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ M] (F : IntermediateField ℚ M) (q : ℕ) (ζ : M), q.Prime → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ q → IntermediateField.adjoin F ({ζ} : Set M) = ⊤ → ∀ (h : M ≃ₐ[F] M) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ W : ValuationSubring M, W.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ W.IsFrobeniusAt h ℓ
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted analytic counting prerequisites with local cyclotomic and ray-class arguments to obtain the prescribed Frobenius prime and valuation.
